newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Jan 20.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Jan 20.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
- China says stand toward Taiwan will not change in 1997, trade volume with Taiwan reaches $14.14 billion in first 10 months of 1996, up 1.0 per cent.
- Propaganda meeting in Beijing calls for good atmosphere in press
- China Securities Regulatory Commissoin rules on supervision of listed firms, including information release and company statements.
- Mobil sets up a $45 million lubricating oil plant in Tianjin,its first investment project in China.
- Jiangsu province registers a $2.5 billiion foreign trade surplus in 1996.
- China's National Petroleum Corp sees profits hit 8.96 billion yuan in 1996.
